episode_summary: In this episode, Vija Williams discusses the importance of adapting to the changing real estate landscape by leveraging cash offer leads to engage with potential sellers early. She emphasizes the need for agents to become consultants and problem solvers, offering multiple solutions to meet the needs of an increasingly educated consumer base. The episode provides actionable insights for team leaders and aspiring top producers to integrate new lead sources and technologies into their strategies.
